description: A soothing and relaxing melody created with the sounds of nature. It is a very subtle tone, so it may be hard to listen.

name: Grassy Glide
effect: Single Target. *If Grassy Terrain is active, this Move has Reaction 1.
description: A single leaf can hold the entire weight of the Pokémon. When moving, it appears to glide over the grass.

name: Grassy Terrain
effect: Target User's side of the field. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice to all Physical & Special Grass-Type Moves. Everyone on the User's side of the field heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will Point to activate. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: A patch of grass grows in the area surrounding the user, through it nature grants her many blessings.

name: Grav Apple
effect: Single Target. Ranged. Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
description: The Pokémon rises on top of its foe and drops an apple on their head. The foe proceeds to eat the apple, distracting it from the fight.

name: Gravity
effect: Target Battlefield. Remove the immunity to Ground-Type Moves for everyone in the field. Moves that require jumping or flying get an Extra "Low Accuracy 2". Duration 4 Rounds.
description: An invisible force pulls everyone to the floor and keeps them from taking off from the ground.

name: Growl
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

name: Growth
effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Special. If the Sunny Weather is active, increase by 2 Instead.
description: The Pokémon makes their body grow in size. They’ll get bigger and stronger in just a few seconds.

name: Grudge
effect: Single Target. The User Faints. Reduce the Target's Will to 0 points and reset any effect it got from spending them. Roll Target's Loyalty at the end of the round, increase difficulty by 1 each round. Failing this roll faints the Target.
description: The last words of this Pokémon imprint their grudge and anger over their foe. Depleting the foe of their will to carry on in this world.

name: Guard Split
effect: Single Target. Average the User's Defense and Sp. Defense with the Target's, rounded down.
description: Through a mental link both Pokémon are aware of each other weaknesses, which end up evening the odds.

name: Guard Swap
effect: Single Target. Whole Scene Duration. Switch the User's Defense and Sp. Defense with the Target's.
description: The Pokémon enters their foe’s mind to steal its fortitude and implant on them the idea of their own weakness.

name: Guillotine
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Deal Damage equal to the Target's Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damage.
description: Fueled by the spirit of revolution, the Pokémon sentences their foe to be reduced at the neck. This devastating attack requires an emergency trip to the Pokémon Center...and a basket.

name: Gunk Shot
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
description: The target is covered head to toe in sludge, filth and organic waste. It can’t even cry for help or all of it will go into its mouth.

name: Gust
effect: Single Target. Wind Move. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyway.
description: The Pokémon flaps their wings and strikes the foe with a swirl of wind. Pokémon in the air may get swept away.

name: Gyro Ball
effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every point on Dexterity the Target has that surpasses the User's. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
description: The Pokémon shoots a projectile. Correction: the Pokémon IS the projectile.

name: Hail
effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Hail Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: The skies turn gray, and loud thunder rumbles, but what falls is not a gentle drizzle, but an endless stream of ice shards coming down at high speeds. Find shelter!

name: Hammer Arm
effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce User's Dexterity by 1.
description: Stop. Hammer Arm time!

name: Hard Press
effect: Single Target. *Reduce 1 Die from the Damage Pool for every missing Hp the User has. Up to 5 Dice may be removed this way.
description: The foe is grappled in a painful lock, the more it struggles to get out the more pressure it’s gonna feel. The user must be in top condition for this grapple to be effective.

name: Harden
effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1.
description: When life gets hard, do the same.

name: Haze
effect: Target Battlefield. Remove all Increased or Reduced Attributes and Traits of everyone on the battlefield.
description: The battlefield is filled with a cleansing cloud that takes away all impurities in the field. It can also work as concealment.

name: Head Charge
effect: Single Target. Recoil.
description: The Pokémon is headstrong, in head-to-head competitions they will always charge head on.

name: Head Smash
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
description: Pokémon, angry. Pokémon, smash!

name: Headbutt
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Out of battle it may cause a Random encounter when hitting trees and make objects drop from high places.
description: The Pokémon rams against their foe with their head. This Move is perfect to shake down trees when looking for berries, but beware of wild Pokémon nesting at the treetops.

name: Headlong Rush
effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
description: This Pokémon is headstrong in a very very literal way.

name: Heal Bell
effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Sound Move. Cure any Status Ailment on the Targets.
description: The soothing chime of a magical bell cleanses all impurities.

name: Heal Block
effect: Area Move. Those affected can't restore HP. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: Through a massive mental onslaught, the Pokémon brings back the memories of pain on everyone around.

name: Heal Order
effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
description: The queen commands the swarm to bring her healing honey.

name: Heal Pulse
effect: Target One Ally. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
description: Commanding the mind over the matter, the Pokémon speeds up the healing process on an ally.

name: Healing Wish
effect: Target Self. The user faints. One allied Target restores its full HP and it is cured from any Status Condition. If the chosen Target is not in-battle, it is called out and ready to fight with the same remaining actions as the user.
description: In a display of true selflessness, the user makes the ultimate sacrifice for the well-being of others.

name: Heart Stamp
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
description: The Pokémon controls the emotions of their victims just as they start to feel loved and safe, the Pokémon strikes. The poor victim is left broken hearted for a few seconds.

name: Heart Swap
effect: Single Target. Switch the User's Trait and Attribute Increases and Reductions with those on the Target's.
description: The User enters the mind of the foe to implant them with their own feelings of insecurity and take the foe’s feelings of confidence in itself.

name: Heat Crash
effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die of Damage for every 50kgs the User is above the Target. Up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
description: The Pokémon sets themselves ablaze and dives as a cannonball against their foe.

name: Heat Wave
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 1st Degree Burn on those affected.
description: A large wave of extra-hot air that can set fire to everything it touches.

name: Heavy Slam
effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool for every 50kg of weight the User is above the target's weight. Up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
description: The foe is about to confirm if the Pokémon is thick-boned.

name: Help Another
effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 1. Roll your Accuracy as if it were Chance dice. Add 1 die to the Accuracy Roll of your Ally for each Success (result of 6) obtained this way. Up to 3 Characters may attempt to help a single Action. Up to 6 Dice may be added this way.
description: Not being the best suited for a task doesn’t mean you won’t do your part in helping out. The best teams work together!

name: Helping Hand
effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 5. The Target Gets 2 Extra Dice on their next Skill Check/Accuracy Roll, and 2 Extra Dice on their next Damage Roll. This Effect does not Stack.
description: The Pokémon is the first to come and give a hand to their friend. A true bro.

name: Hex
effect: Single Target. *If the Target has an active Status Condition, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
description: The user casts a terrible hex over the target, the effects will be greater if the target is already burdened by an ailment.

name: Hidden Power
effect: Single Target. This Move will always deal Super-Effective Damage against the Target. If used by the Pokemon #201 Unown. See p. 530
description: Inside every Pokémon lies the key to unlock all kinds of power.

name: High Horsepower
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1.
description: The Pokémon tramples their foe without mercy. Their powerful body could pull a traction vehicle for very long distances.

name: High Jump Kick
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. If the Accuracy roll fails, Roll 5 Dice of Typeless Damage against the user, ignoring defenses.
description: The user launches itself up three stories high to pummel down with a brutal kick. Let’s just trust it’s got a good aim from that distance.

name: Hold Hands
effect: Single Target. The battle may end at the Storyteller's discretion. Target may resist rolling their Will Score against the Accuracy of this Move. Out of battle, aid to reduce hostile intent.
description: The user offers their hand in friendship, if the other Pokémon holds their hand they’ll be very happy and become good friends.

name: Hone Claws
effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength score and Accuracy Pools.
description: Sharp claws make for more precise and deadly attacks.

name: Horn Attack
effect: Single Target.
description: The user has horns. Did you not expect they’ll use them?

name: Horn Drill
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Deal Damage equal to the Target's Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damage.
description: The Pokémon stabs the target with a spinning horn, drilling through them until they are in critical condition. Hurry to the nearest Pokémon Center.

name: Horn Leech
effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
description: The user rams into the foe and uses the leaves growing on their horns to absorb nutrients from it.

name: Howl
effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Sound Move. Increase by 1 the Strength of those affected.
description: If you hear the howl, the pack has already surrounded you.

name: Hurricane
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target. Rain Weather eliminates Low Accuracy. Sunny Weather increases to Low Accuracy 4. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyways.
description: The Pokémon calls upon fierce gale winds. It’ll be difficult to summon the tempest on a clear day, but a little rain will enhance it into a typhoon. Other pokémon in the air are in most danger.

name: Hydro Cannon
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge.
description: Those who fear fire’s destructive power have forgotten that water triumphs over the flames every single time.

name: Hydro Pump
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2
description: Water works best under pressure.

name: Hydro Steam
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target. *If Sunny Weather is active, this Move does not reduce damage due to it, and has 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move.
description: When water and fire work together you’ll wish they didn’t set aside their differences.

name: Hydro Vortex
effect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Hyper Beam
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
description: A devastating beam, a path of destruction that can extend for miles is the unmistakable proof someone used this Move. Let the user rest before trying to use it again.

name: Hyper Drill
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Ignore Shield Moves active on the Foe or their side of the field.
description: Using their tail as a powerful drill, the Pokémon pierces through any surface it comes in contact with.

name: Hyper Fang
effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 1 Chance die to Flinch the Target.
description: The Pokémon bites hard into the foe, leaving nasty teeth marks.

name: Hyper Voice
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move.
description: The user screeches or sings at such high frequencies that anything made of glass will break. The ears of the victims are left in no better state.

name: Hyperspace Fury
effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Ignores the effect of any Force Field or Shield Move active on the foe's side. Reduce the User's Defense by 1.
description: The Pokémon opens portals to attack with each one of its arms, bypassing all defenses and making it impossible to escape; however, portals go both ways.

name: Hyperspace Hole
effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Unique. Ignore Defenses. Ignore Shield Moves and Force Field.
description: The laws of physics forbid one object from being in many places at once and from occupying the same space as other bodies. But the user disregards their authority.

name: Hypnosis
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Put the Target to sleep. Dark-Type Pokemon are affected by this Move.
description: By staring at an hypnotic pendulum, the target is suggested to feel tired and close its eyelids.

name: Ice Ball
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Projectile Move. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the last hit of this Move. If the Pokemon used the Move "Defense Curl" in the same round, this Move's base Power becomes 2.
description: The Pokémon rolls into a snowball, getting bigger and bigger as they keep rolling

name: Ice Beam
effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze the Target.
description: The Pokémon shoots a cold beam that reduces all warmth in the environment down to the freezing point.

name: Ice Burn
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Charge Move. Unique. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
description: The user appears to become a block of ice, then it releases themselves from the ice with a devastating explosion. The exploding ice shards and fire blow all over the battlefield.

name: Ice Fang
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
description: The Pokémon bites their foe with sharp teeth and a gelid breath to chill their bones directly

name: Ice Hammer
effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce User's Dexterity by 1.
description: The Pokémon uses its powerful gelid arms and strikes the foe with a swing motion.

name: Ice Punch
effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
description: The Pokémon wears their ice gloves to punch the foe. Yes. Gloves made of ice.

name: Ice Shard
effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Ranged.
description: With extraordinary swiftness, the Pokémon shoots an ice bullet like the fastest gun in the North Pole.

name: Ice Spinner
effect: Single Target. Remove any active Terrain on the Battlefield.
description: The user covers their feet with sharp ice blades and skates through the field making gracious spins to hit the target. The battlefield ends up cut by the blades though.

name: Icicle Crash
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
description: The Pokémon creates a big stalactite on top of the foe and lets it fall on top of it. Sometimes they manage to impale the foe to the ground.

name: Icicle Spear
effect: Single Target. Ranged. Successive Actions.
description: A barrage of icicles shot against the target. They are small but sharp and pointy

name: Icy Wind
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Wind Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
description: Polar winds sweep through the arena. Everyone starts to shiver and embrace themselves, trying to preserve a bit of warmth.

name: Imprison
effect: Target Self. While the User is on the battlefield, Moves known by the User cannot be used by foes. This effect ends if the User is removed from battle.
description: This move blocks all shared parts of a memory the user is well aware of. Moves, techniques, names, places, people or situations, no one will be able to recall those imprisoned memories.

name: Incinerate
effect: Single Target. All Foes in Range. Destroy the held item of those affected.
description: A small blast of fire that instantly consumes small flammable objects.

name: Infernal Parade
effect: Single Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Foe. *If the Target has an active Status Condition, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
description: 'You may not be the type to faint when things are odd or things are quaint. But seeing flames you know that ain’t will scorch you into dismay't will scorch you into dismay.'

name: Inferno
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Lethal. Inflict 3rd Degree Burn on the Target.
description: The user sets their target on fire with unforgiving flames. Abandon all hope.

name: Inferno Overdrive
effect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Infestation
effect: Single Target. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
description: The Pokémon summons a bothersome swarm to prevent the foe from escaping. The swarm will relentlessly attack the foe.

name: Ingrain
effect: Target Self. The User heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will point to activate. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
description: The Pokémon roots themselves to absorb nutrients directly from the ground.

name: Instruct
effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.
description: The Pokémon sends a psychic command to a target, enabling the user to mentally tell them what to do. If you see a Pokémon attacking their own allies... this was it.

name: Ion Deluge
effect: Target Battlefield. Damage from Normal-Type Moves will be considered to be Electric-Type. Whole Scene Duration.
description: The user electrifies all the particles in the environment with shocking results!

name: Iron Defense
effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

name: Iron Head
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to flinch the Target.
description: The Pokémon charges to cure the foe’s iron deficiency.

name: Iron Tail
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
description: With a hardened tail, the Pokémon swings against the foe to make a dent in their armor.

name: Ivy Cudgel
effect: Single Target. *The Type of this Move becomes the same as the User's Secondary Type if possible Otherwise their Main Type. This affects Weakness, Resistances, and STAB accordingly.
description: The Pokémon creates a club out of thorny ivy vines, this club is infused with the power of nature, everchanging.

name: Jaw Lock
effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Blocks both User and Target. Whole Scene Duration.
description: The user will capture its foe in a crushing jaw grip. It won’t let go no matter how much you try to separate them. The only way it will release its victim is if one of them faints.

name: Jet Punch
effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Fist Move.
description: The fist of justice strikes true, swift...and wet!

name: Judgment
effect: Single Target. Unique. Ignore Defenses. This Move's Type, Power and extra Added Effects are decided by Storyteller. If something would prevent this Move from dealing Damage, ignore it. This Move can't be Clashed.
description: Sooner or later, everyone gets what they deserve.

name: Jump Kick
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. If the Accuracy roll fails, Roll 4 Dice of Typeless Damage against the user, ignoring defenses.
description: The user launches itself up two stories high to pummel down with a powerful kick. Do not try it at home.

name: Jungle Healing
effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Heal any Status Ailment (Burn, Freeze, Paralysis, Poison & Sleep) on the Targets. Restore 1 HP to the targets. If successful spend 1 Will point to activate.
description: A stream of life force from plants and trees flow into the User and their Allies.

name: Karate Chop
effect: Single Target. High Critical.
description: A classic karate technique, the chop that has been practiced and mastered.

name: Kinesis
effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
description: A basic display of psychic abilities, making objects and other creatures levitate for a short period of time.

name: King's Shield
effect: Target Self. Reaction 4. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage the User would receive from a Damaging Move. *If the Foe used a Non-Ranged Physical Move against the user, Reduce the foe's Strength by 2.
description: Off my chair, jester! The king sits there!

name: Knock Off
effect: Single Target. *If the Target is holding an Item, Add 2 Dice to the Damage pool of this Move. The Target loses its Held Item afterwards.
description: The Pokémon rudely smacks what their foe was holding.

name: Kowtow Cleave
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Cutter Move. Never Miss.
description: The user gets on their knees and bows to its foe, then as the foe accepts this courtesy, a treacherous slash reveals the evil intent of the ruse.

name: Land's Wrath
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Ranged. Lethal. Unique.
description: The earth moves on its own, no attacker in sight. The floor crumbles and the ground shakes engulfing its victims. From the rubble, lush trees emerge a short time after.

name: Laser Focus
effect: Target Self. If the next Physical or Special Move the user performs gets 5 more successes required on the Accuracy Roll, ignore the Target's defenses on the Damage roll.
description: Through its incredible awareness the Pokémon finds a straight path into a weak point of the foe. The attack that follows is devastating.

name: Lash Out
effect: Single Target. *Add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move if any of the user's Attributes/Traits were lowered this Round.
description: The user fulminates the foe with the power of its frustration and a shriek of despair.

name: Last Resort
effect: Single Target. This Move will fail if the User has not successfully performed all of its known Moves at least once during the battle.
description: The Pokémon may be out of energy, but never out of options.

name: Last Respects
effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move for every ally that Fainted during this Battle Up to 8 Dice may be added this way.
description: The Pokémon gathers the souls the departed and helps them fulfill their desire of revenge before moving on.

name: Lava Plume
effect: Area Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on those affected.
description: The floor is lava. The sky is lava. Everywhere is lava. Hundreds of lava bits start raining scattered around the field.

name: Leaf Blade
effect: Single Target. High Critical. Lethal. Cutter Move.
description: Danger lies not in the material’s toughness but in its edge’s sharpness.

name: Leaf Storm
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce the User's Special by 2.
description: A furious onslaught of sharp leaves blasting against the target. The user gives their all in this attack.

name: Leaf Tornado
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce 1 Success from all Accuracy Rolls of the foe.
description: A cluster of leaves and twigs swirls around the foe, getting in its eyes and making it difficult to aim properly

name: Leafage
effect: Single Target. Ranged.
description: The user throws leaf darts towards the foe.

name: Leech Life
effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
description: The Pokémon clings to their foe, then bites in and starts to suck away its life force.

name: Leech Seed
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Spend 1 Will point to activate. At the end of each Round, Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against the target ignoring defenses. The User heals 1 HP for every damage dealt this way. Grass-Type Pokémon are immune to this Effect. Whole Scene Duration.
description: The foe is infected with seed saplings taking root on their body. As the saplings grow, they'll absorb the vital energy of the foe and send it back to the user.

name: Leer
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

name: Lick
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
description: The Pokémon licks the foe. The foe is deeply disturbed by this creepy display of “affection”.

name: Life Dew
effect: Target User and Allies in Range. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. User and Allies in Range heal 1 HP at the end of each Round. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: The user creates a fresh-water dew that restores energy and heals wounds.

name: Light Of Ruin
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Recoil. Lethal. Unique.
description: By drawing energy from the Eternal Flower, the Pokémon unleashes all of its hurt. A beautiful light surrounds the area, yet the pain inside of its heart remains.

name: Light Screen
effect: Target the User's side of the field. Force Field. Activate a Force Field against Special Damage. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: A barrier of light is created over half of the battlefield, all energy trying to go trough dissolves as it crosses it.

name: Liquidation
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
description: The Pokémon strikes while bursting a full-force blast of pressurized water. The water may cut or dent through the target’s armor.

name: Lock-On
effect: Target Self. The Next Move the User Performs has 2 automatic successes added on their Accuracy Roll.
description: The Pokémon’s eyes zoom into a moving target to strike with precision at the next opportunity.

name: Lovely Kiss
effect: Single Target. Put the Target to Sleep. Pokemon with this Move may forfeit their Beauty score completely, restore 1 Point to their Beauty Score. If the Pokemon forgets this move, restore 1 point to their Beauty Score.
description: A true love’s kiss that could turn any prince into a froakie and put any princess to sleep for a hundred years.

name: Low Kick
effect: Single Target. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice for every 50kg of the weight on the foe, up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
description: The Pokémon uses a kick to the shin to throw the foe into the ground. The bigger they are, the harder they fall.

name: Low Sweep
effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
description: The Pokémon crouches and spins with a kick to the foe’s legs. Leaving them with a limp for the rest of the fight.

name: Lucky Chant
effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Unique. Targets can Re-roll one un-successful die from all their rolls. Critical Hits do not grant Bonus dice against the Targets. Whole Scene Duration. Out of battle, good things happen at Storyteller's Discretion.
description: The magical incantation of an old priestess, through dance and song, good fortune and divine protection will come to you. This Move also removes evil spirits and curses.

name: Lumina Crash
effect: Single Target. Reduce the Foe's Sp. Defense by 2.
description: The user flashes a light pattern that crashes the foe’s mind, leaving it acting erratically for a few moments.

name: Lunar Blessing
effect: *Target User or Target one Ally. Unique. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Complete Heal. Heal all status Ailments on the Target. Reduce 1 success to all Accuracy Rolls of one foe.
description: Put your faith on the moon, pray during dark times and it shall bring light into your heart, guide the strayed, and cast away the creatures from the shadows.

name: Lunar Dance
effect: Target Self. Unique. Roll the User's Remaining HP as Typeless Damage dice to itself. One allied Target restores its full HP and it is cured from any Status Condition, if it was fainted, restore consciousness. If the chosen Target is not in-battle, it is called out and ready to fight with the same remaining actions as the user.
description: The moon shines at the darkest hours, reflecting sun’s life-bringing light on those fallen into the night. Cresselia takes pity of their lost souls and guides them towards the dawn.

name: Lunge
effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 1.
description: The user charges against the foe at full force, not just to knock it down but to restrain it with its many limbs.

name: Luster Purge
effect: Single Target. Unique. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce Sp. Defense by 1. *This effect can stack up to 3 times per Target.
description: The user engulfs itself in a blinding light and shoots a light beam at its foe. This light leaves the foe powerless to resist the assault.

name: Mach Punch
effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Fist Move.
description: The user launches a punch so quickly that it’s barely seen.

name: Magic Coat
effect: Target Self. Reaction 4. Support Moves that would target the user or its side of the field are inflicted to the foe performing the Move or that foe's side of the field instead.
description: Through a swift mind trick the Pokémon trick the foe into pouring their ill intent on itself.

name: Magic Powder
effect: Single Target. Powder Move. Change the target's Type to Psychic.
description: The Pokémon recites an enchantment and blows a cloud of pink dust on its Target. Afterwards, the target becomes incredibly good at guessing which card you got from a deck.

name: Magic Room
effect: Target Battlefield. Held items lose their effects. No items can be used. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: The entire battlefield becomes a room on which the laws of the material world are rendered useless.

name: Magical Leaf
effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
description: The user sends out a floating leaf that will pursue the target until it hits.

name: Magical Torque
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance dice to Confuse the Target.
description: With the flick of a wand the user is spun around in a magic swirl that leaves them absolutely dizzy.

name: Magma Storm
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Blocks. Roll 3 Fire-Type Damage Dice ignoring defenses at the end of each Round. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: The Pokémon shoots a fiery eruption to its foe. Unable to escape and surrounded by the unbearable heat the foe’s survival is at risk.

name: Magnet Bomb
effect: Single Target. Ranged. Never Miss. Projectile Move.
description: The user lights the fuse of a magnetized bomb. Guess who is the other magnet?

name: Magnet Rise
effect: Target Self. The User gains Immunity against Ground-Type Moves. Whole Scene Duration
description: The Pokémon creates a magnetic field to repel themselves from the ground, allowing it to float for a short period of time.

name: Magnetic Flux
effect: Target User and Allies in range. Increase by 1 the Defense and Sp. Defense of Electric-Type or Steel-Type Targets.
description: The Pokémon alters the magnetic field around itself to repel damage. This also affects other Pokémon sensible to magnetic charges.

name: Magnitude
effect: Area Move. Ranged. Before you roll damage, Roll 1 die to determine this Move's Power. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
description: The user shakes the tectonic plates underneath the battlefield, trying to find a fault; when they do, this Move is devastating.

name: Make It Rain
effect: Area Move. Reduce the User's Special by 2. At the end of the battle give the User and every Trainer whose Pokemon was hit, Money equal to their Rank: Starter/Rookie - 100 Standard - 250 Advanced - 500 Ace or more - 1000
description: The Pokémon calls a rain of gold to fall from the sky. All the greedy Pokémon who threw themselves at the money get in range for an explosion of golden light. Worth it!

name: Malignant Chain
effect: Single Target. Unique. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Badly Poison the Target. At the end of the Round, if the Target was Poisoned by this Move, roll their Loyalty, get at least 3 successes, if it fails, from the next Round the Target becomes the user's Ally until the poison is healed.
description: This chain contains the most potent neurotoxin currently known. It boosts physical appearance, yet totally suppresses the mind and soul, turning the target into the user’s puppet.

name: Mat Block
effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Shield Move. Reaction 1. Reduce 3 Damage from a Physical or Special Move.
description: The Pokémon uses a mat as a shield.

name: Matcha Gotcha
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Projectile Move. Low Accuracy 1. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target. If the user is Frozen solid, destroy the ice block.
description: The user invites the foe to an herbal tea ceremony. As the tea is served and the foe is off guard, the user throws the hot tea on them, then proceeds to enjoy their own cup.

name: Max Airstream
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Increase the Dexterity of User and Allies in Range by 1.

name: Max Darkness
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Reduce by 1 the Sp. Defense of those Affected.

name: Max Flare
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Activate the Effects of Sunny Weather (Disregard time of day or location) Duration 4 Rounds.

name: Max Flutterby
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Reduce by 1 the Special of those Affected.

name: Max Geyser
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Activate the Effects of Rain Weather. (Disregard location) Duration 4 Rounds.

name: Max Guard
effect: Target Max Self. Shield Move. Reaction 5. Reduce 5 Damage this Max Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Any Move that targets the Max User

name: Max Hailstorm
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Activate the Effects of Hail Weather. (Disregard location) Duration 4 Rounds.

name: Max Knuckle
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Increase he Strength of Userand Allies in Range by 1.

name: Max Lightning
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Activate the Effects of Electric Terrain. Duration 4 Rounds.

name: Max Mindstorm
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Activate the Effects of Psychic Terrain. Duration 4 Rounds.

name: Max Ooze
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Increase the Special of User and Allies in Range by 1.

name: Max Overgrowth
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Activate the Effects of Grassy Terrain. Duration 4 Rounds.

name: Max Phantasm
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those Affected.

name: Max Quake
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Increase the Sp. Defense of the User and Allies in Range by 1.

name: Max Rockfall
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Activate the Effects of Sandstorm Weather. (Disregard location Duration 4 Rounds.

name: Max Starfall
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Activate the Effects of Misty Terrain. Duration 4 Rounds.

name: Max Steelspike
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Increase the Defense of the User and Allies in Range by 1.

name: Max Strike
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those Affected.

name: Max Wyrmwind
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those Affected.

name: Me First
effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Copy Move. Support Moves can't be copied. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.
description: The user anticipates the next Move the target will use and impatiently interrupts to be the first in line.

name: Mean Look
effect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
description: An intense and ever-vigilant stare that surveils all possible paths the foe has to escape.

name: Meditate
effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Special and Sp. Defense.
description: Through meditation the Pokémon brings forward their mind’s strength into their body.

name: Mega Drain
effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
description: The user absorbs a big amount of vital energy and nutrients from the target to feed from.

name: Mega Kick
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2.
description: A mighty kick. This sheer muscle-power strike can turn concrete pillars into rubble.

name: Mega Punch
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Fist Move.
description: The Pokémon packs everything into this punch to pulverize their foe with a single strike.

name: Megahorn
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal.
description: The Pokémon uses its strong horn(s) to pierce their foe and deal massive damage.

name: Memento
effect: Single Target. The User faints. Reduce by 2 the foe's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense, and Sp. Defense. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
description: As they take their last breath, the Pokémon leaves behind an imprint of regret on their foe.

name: Metal Burst
effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Physical or Special Move. Roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
description: Those who live by the sword will die by the sword, or, in this case, by an explosion.

name: Metal Claw
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase the User's Strength by 1.
description: The Pokémon uses the foe as a whetstone.

name: Metal Sound
effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 2.
description: A horrible screeching sound rumbles in the foe’s ears. Some people will try to convince you that this is good music.

name: Meteor Assault
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Must Recharge.
description: The Pokémon will make an incredible jump to the sky, then lunge towards the foe at a staggering speed, crashing the ground upon impact. The user is left very tired.

name: Meteor Beam
effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Increase the User's Special by 1 the moment it begins charging.
description: The user overflows with galactic energy while summoning a small meteor to impact the foe. A theory suggests this move might have caused the extinction of prehistoric Pokémon.

name: Meteor Mash
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Fist Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to increase the User's Strength by 1.
description: A great meteor fell, leading to the extinction of all prehistoric Pokémon. The user re-enacts that meteor on a smaller scale, as it only needs to extinguish one.

name: Metronome
effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Roll a die to determine Physical or Special category, roll a die to determine this Move's Power. The appearance, Type and added effects of this Move becomes the same of a Physical or Special Move of the same Power at Storyteller's Discretion.
description: The Pokémon waves their hands following a specific rhythm, the energy around follows the cadence and manifests as a Move at random.

name: Mighty Cleave
effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Ignore Shield Moves & Force Fields active on the foe or their side of the field.
description: With a mighty light, the Pokémon cleaves through the foe’s protections and strikes like a boulder.

name: Milk Drink
effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Out of battle, this Move can be used on allies.
description: The Pokémon drinks a glass of milk. Full of calcium and vitamin D it is a healthy and delicious refreshment.

name: Mimic
effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Replace "Mimic" with the copied Move. Whole Scene Duration.
description: The Pokémon is a quick learner. They imitate their target’s movements and just like that they get a new set of powers.

name: Mind Blown
effect: Area Move. Recoil.
description: The Pokémon has had a terrible day and has a headache to match. Try not to disturb the peace because their head really feels like exploding.

name: Mind Reader
effect: Single Target. The User has 2 automatic and unremovable successes on the next Accuracy or Evasion Roll against the Target.
description: In a split of second, the Pokémon reads the foe’s mind so they know exactly what to do next.

name: Minimize
effect: Target Self. The User can now make up to 5 Evasions per Round. Reduce the User's Height and Weight in half. The user is now Vulnerable to: Stomp. Whole Scene Duration.
description: The Pokémon compacts their body. Becoming a much smaller target to be difficult to hit. But a well placed stomp may leave them squished on the floor, though.

name: Miracle Eye
effect: Target Self. The User's Psychic-Type Moves ignore Dark-Type Immunity. Target cannot Evade the User's Moves. This Pokemon's Accuracy cannot be Reduced by Move's, Items or Abilities (ie Sand Attack, Bright Powder, etc.). Whole Scene Duration
description: The Pokémon opens up the third eye. Their sight transcends the barriers of flesh. No one goes undetected.

name: Mirror Coat
effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Special Move. For damage, roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2. Ignore Defenses.
description: The user gathers the harmful energies around themselves and bounces them back to their source.

name: Mirror Move
effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.
description: The Pokémon parrots the target cries and movements. In an almost perfect impersonation that manages to copy its powers.

name: Mirror Shot
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
description: Through a series of reflective surfaces, the Pokémon redirects a beam through unexpected directions. The foe is at a loss; they don’t know if what they see is real or a reflection.

name: Mist
effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Targets cannot have their Attributes or Traits Reduced. Previously Reduced Attributes and Traits remain. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: A thick layer of mist cloaks a pack of pokémon, those with the intent to trick and weaken them will have to find them first.

name: Mist Ball
effect: Single Target. Unique. Projectile Move. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Special by 1. *This Effect can be stacked up to 3 times per target.
description: The user engulfs its foe with a cloud, this soothing mist keeps evil intents from surfacing into the Target’s mind.

name: Misty Explosion
effect: Area Attack. Lethal. The User faints after using this Move. *If Misty Terrain is active, add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
description: The user razes the field with a searing nuke made of love, joy, kisses, and pink glitter. It is deadly.

name: Misty Terrain
effect: Target Battlefield. All Status Ailments and Conditions are cured and no more can be inflicted. Physical & Special Dragon-Type Moves have Power 0. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: The battlefield is shrouded by a pink mist that feels protective and soothing. This mist is able to render even the fiercest beasts into calm.

name: Moonblast
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce Target's Special by 1.
description: The user becomes a champion of lunar justice. In the name of the moon, they will right the wrongs and triumph over evil!

name: Moongeist Beam
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. If anything on the foe's side would prevent this move from dealing damage (Pokemon Type, Abilities, Shield Moves, Weather or Force Fields) ignore it. This Move cannot be clashed.
description: A cold reflection of the moon shines upon the target, it doesn’t hurt physically but those who stare directly into the light simply collapse.

name: Moonlight
effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Night Time and Sunny Weather increase it to Complete Heal. Rain, Sandstorm and Hail Weather reduce to Minor Heal of 1 HP.
description: The Pokémon uses the moon’s power to heal their injuries.

name: Morning Sun
effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. If Sunny Weather is in effect, this Move becomes a Complete Heal. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm, Hail or Snowy Weather, this Move is a Minor heal only heals 1 HP.
description: The Pokémon feels revitalized with the bright sun early in the mornings.

name: Mortal Spin
effect: All Foes in Range. Poison those Affected. Remove Entry Hazards, Terrains (ie Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain), Ongoing Damage and Leech seed from the User or their side of the field.
description: The user spins around the field, cutting through obstacles and shooting small darts full of a toxic venom. The earth is now poisoned and left barren.

name: Mountain Gale
effect: Single Target. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
description: If the foe does not go to the mountain, hurl the mountain into the foe.

name: Mud Bomb
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Projectile Move. Roll 3 Chance Die to Reduce 1 success to all Accuracy rolls of the Target.
description: The Pokémon shoots a ball of mud to burst in their victim’s face in an attempt to blind them.

name: Mud Shot
effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
description: By shooting a stream of mud at their target, the user manages to impair their movement.

name: Mud Slap
effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
description: A mud ball splatters right into the foe’s face, reducing their field of vision.

name: Mud Sport
effect: Target Battlefield. Physical & Special Electric-Type Moves have Power 0. Pokemon weak to Electric-Type Moves won't receive Super-Effective Damage from them. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: The user covers the whole field with mud. Electricity can’t flow properly, so Electric attacks will be severely impaired.

name: Muddy Water
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of those affected.
description: When you can’t see what creatures lurk inside the water, that’s when you know they are the ones that went fishing.

name: Multi-Attack
effect: Single Target. Unique. This Move's type will change to match the User's Main Type.
description: A weird-looking Pokémon charged against its foes, the same attack released different kinds of energy depending on the disk the Pokémon is holding.

name: Mystical Fire
effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Special by 1.
description: An iridescent fire that burns not just in the physical world but in the spiritual world as well.

name: Mystical Power
effect: Target Self. Increase by 2 the User's lowest Attribute/Trait. If an Attribute/Trait Score is 6 or More, this effect fails. Different Attributes/Traits may be increased this way.
description: The power is inside you. You can feel it in your heart, you can see it in your mind. Believe in yourself and take it!

name: Nasty Plot
effect: Target Self. Increase User's Special by 2.
description: Rubbing both hands and laughing sinisterly the Pokémon rejoices in the evil plans they’ll soon carry out.

name: Natural Gift
effect: Single Target. Ranged. The User loses its held berry. *The Type of this Move changes according to the berry used. See more on p. 530
description: The user throws their held berry at the foe, the myriad of flavors has surprisingly different results.

name: Nature Power
effect: Single Target. *The Type of this Move is determined by the environment or active Terrain. See more on p. 530
description: The Pokémon makes use of the terrain and asks for nature's aid in battle.

name: Nature's Madness
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Damage Roll is Half of the Target's remaining HP (up to 10 Dice) Rounded down. If the remaining HP of the Target is 1, this move fails. Ignore Defenses.
description: The forces of nature attack as if they had a will of their own. Water will try to drown you, plants will trap you, lightning will come out of nowhere, even your own body will fail you.

name: Needle Arm
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
description: The Pokémon flails their arms with violence against the foe, the arms have grown thorns that sting like needles.

name: Never-Ending Nightmare
effect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Ignore Ability, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Night Daze
effect: Single Target. Roll 4 Chance Dice to Reduce 1 Success from all Accuracy rolls of the foe. Outside of battle, obscuring effects last for a whole scene.
description: The foe is engulfed by a pitch-black darkness that obscures its vision and torments its mind.

name: Night Shade
effect: Single Target. Roll Ghost-Type Damage Dice according to the User's Rank: Starter 1 Die / Rookie 2 Dice / Standard 4 Dice/ Advanced 6 Dice / Expert 8 Dice / Ace and forward 10 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
description: The user casts a dark and frightening mirage surrounding the foe to give them a panic attack.

name: Night Slash
effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
description: The user looks for a weak spot, tearing the soft flesh apart with a single vile slash of its claws.

name: Nightmare
effect: Single Target. Can only be used if the Target has the Sleep Condition. Deal 1 Typeless Damage to the Target after every attempt to resist its Sleep Condition where it doesn't wake up.
description: The user is believed to transport themselves to the land of dreams to torment their victims with vivid night terrors. The victims wake up with unexplainable injuries.

name: No Retreat
effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
description: No surrender. No retreat. Until victory, always!

name: Noble Roar
effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Target's Strength and Special.
description: The mighty roar of a king. It commands respect and authority over anyone who listens.

name: Noxious Torque
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
description: Surrounded by noxious gases, the victim is spun around at high speeds.

name: Nuzzle
effect: Single Target. Paralyze the foe.
description: The Pokémon gives a cute nuzzle at their target, it looks adorable until you see the sparks.

name: Oblivion Wing
effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Unique.
description: A dark wind rises, turning everything it touches into dust to be scattered until nothing remains. People, Pokémon, plants, everything fades like a distant memory.

name: Obstruct
effect: Target Self. Reaction 4. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage the User would receive from a Damaging Move. *If the Foe used a Non-Ranged Physical Move against the user Reduce the foe's Defense by 2.
description: In a reckless action, the user charges against the foe to stop its momentum and block its incoming attack. Being so close allows the user to reach for weak spots.

name: Octazooka
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Projectile Move. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce 1 success to all Accuracy Rolls of the foe.
description: A jet of black ink shot straight into the foe’s eyes. This Move is hard to aim but returns the favor.

name: Octolock
effect: Single Target. Block. Reduce by 1 the Target's Defense and Sp. Defense.
description: The user wraps its tentacles to immobilize the foe. Being so close enables the user to find weak spots.

name: Odor Sleuth
effect: Single Target. The Foe cannot Evade Moves performed by the User. User ignores Ghost-Type immunity to Normal and Fight-Type Moves and vice versa. Out of battle, Add successes of this Move to any roll for Tracking targets.
description: The Pokémon uses their keen sense of smell to corner the foe and find it when it tries to scurry away

name: Ominous Wind
effect: Single Target. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense.
description: The battlefield gets absolutely silent, the only noise is a cold wind draft that gives the target chills and goosebumps. Observing from the shadows, the user rejoices in the fear.

name: Order Up
effect: Single Target. Unique. If the User is giving cover to a #978 Tatsugiri Ally. Increase by 1 an Attribute depending on the Ally's color. *Orange - Strength *Red - Defense *Yellow - Dexterity
description: The user waits for orders and adheres to the strategy of a smaller but smarter ally.

name: Origin Pulse
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Unique. Ignore the Target's immunity to Water-Type Damage. If a Target is "Out of Range" due to using a Move, this Move hits anyways.
description: The Pokémon sends a giant pulse underwater that creates a chain reaction in the tides, creating a series of tsunami waves. Not even water-pokemon can surf through these wild currents.

name: Outrage
effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
description: The true nature of dragon-types unleashed. The user is consumed by a primal fury that won’t stop until everything has ben razed to the ground. Afterwards the Pokémon is confused.

name: Overdrive
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move.
description: The Pokémon uses its own body as an amplifier for the energizing sounds it produces.

name: Overheat
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Reduce User's Special by 2.
description: A furious scorching flame that turns everything in the user’s radius to ash. This incredible destructive display leaves the user exhausted.

name: Pain Split
effect: Single Target. Spend 1 Will Point to activate. *Deal up to 3 Typeless Damage to the Target, Heal 1 HP to the User for every Damage dealt this way. This Move Fails if the User has more than Half HP rounded down. This Move cannot reduce a Target to less than 1 HP.
description: The user channels their pain into the foe to relieve their agony. The foe gets to feel the burn of the damage it has caused.

name: Parabolic Charge
effect: Area Move. The User restore HP equal to half the damage to one Target, rounded down.
description: The Pokémon lets loose a big electric charge from its body. The charge comes back to it even bigger.

name: Parting Shot
effect: Single Target. Switcher Move for the User. Reduce by 1 the Foe's Strength and Special.
description: The user throws one last threat against the foe before taking their leave. The foe is left too frightened to try to stand up against the user and their gang.

name: Pay Day
effect: Single Target. Ranged. At the end of the battle give Money to your Trainer Equal to their Rank: Starter/Rookie - 100 Standard - 250 Advanced - 500 Ace or more - 1000
description: This Pokémon brings good fortune to businesses and trainers alike. Make sure to use some of that hard earned money to buy them a treat.

name: Payback
effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the User has already received Damage from the Target this Round.
description: Some say the best revenge is a successful and happy life, but not this Pokémon.

name: Peck
effect: Single Target.
description: Raise crows and they’ll peck your foe’s eyes.

name: Perish Song
effect: Area Move. Sound Move. Three Rounds after this Move is used, deal damage to those affected equal to their remaining HP. Removing from battle prevents this effect.
description: A song for mourning the departed. Although it sounds beautiful, it fills the heart with grief and despair, making the listeners feel as if they were laying on their death bed.

name: Petal Blizzard
effect: Area Move. Ranged. Wind Move.
description: A raging blizzard of petals and leaves sweeps through the entire area, leaving a pleasant floral scent and destruction in its wake.

name: Petal Dance
effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
description: The Pokémon casts a huge cluster of petals to dance in the wind; they let nature run its course, as the wind will choose who will take the devastating blow.

name: Phantom Force
effect: Single Target. Charge move. Out of Range while Charging. Lethal. Ignore any Cover, Shield Moves, and/or Force Fields active on the Target.
description: The Pokémon disappears into a dark dimension to infiltrate even the most impenetrable fortress. It may reappear during its next action.

name: Photon Geyser
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. This Move's Damage Pool, can be rolled with either Strength or Special Attribute, dealing Physical or Special Damage respectively. Choose whatever is most convenient for the user.
description: The Pokémon attacks with a large pillar of light that comes out from where they stand, either the blazing energy or the crushing strike are enough to knock foes out.

name: Pika Papow
effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every point of Happiness on the User. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way. If the user of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.
description: The User lets out its energy in the form of a lightning strike, the happier the user feels the more energized it will be.

name: Pin Missile
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Successive Actions.
description: The Pokémon shoots a barrage of stingers or spikes that pierce like needles.

name: Plasma Fists
effect: Single Target. Fist Move. If successful, all Normal-Type Moves of the User will be considered Electric-Type. Whole Scene Duration.
description: The user charges its fists with electricity, upon impact, the charge materializes into plasma that adds an electric element to all of its Normal moves.

name: Play Nice
effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Strength by 1.
description: The Pokémon starts to play with the foe. They are friendly, respectful, and thank the foe for the fun time. The foe does not want to fight, they want to keep playing.

name: Play Rough
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Reduce Target's Strength by 1.
description: The Pokémon and their foe start a playful wrestle that soon escalates into a furious wrestling match.

name: Pluck
effect: Single Target. *If the Target is holding a Berry, Add 1 Die to the Damage pool of this Move. The User also eats the berry and gains its effects.
description: The Pokémon lands on top of the foe and starts pecking them in search for parasites or some other tasty treat to snack on.

name: Poison Fang
effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Badly Poison the Target.
description: The Pokémon goes for a quick bite, releasing the foe just as fast. Let the poison slowly consume the foe from the inside out. No need to spend more energy when a drop is more than enough.

name: Poison Gas
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Poison those affected.
description: A thick cloud of toxic gas that causes violent coughs and red eyes.

name: Poison Jab
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
description: The Pokémon is set on injecting venom directly into the foe’s bloodstream. They can do it the easy way or the hard way.

name: Poison Powder
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Powder Move. Poison the Target.
description: A cloud of noxious powder that immediately sends the target’s immune system into overdrive.

name: Poison Sting
effect: Single Target. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
description: A tiny stab that causes big troubles.

name: Poison Tail
effect: Single Target. High Critical. Roll 1 Chance Die to Poison the Target.
description: A sharp edge dipped in venom—an attack in bad blood in all senses of the word.

name: Pollen Puff
effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. * Or target One Ally. *When this move is used against an ally, it will heal 2 HP instead of damage, Spend 1 Will Point to get this effect.
description: The Pokémon creates a puff of pollen that explodes on the foe's face and gives them a terrible allergy. When consumed, these puffs are sweet and very nutritious.

name: Poltergeist
effect: Single Target. Can only be used if the Target is Holding an Item or if Items have been used on the Target's side of the field.
description: The Pokémon’s spirit possesses an Item and attacks with that cursed object. It is said that if the Pokémon lingers too long possessing an object, it’ll have trouble getting out.

name: Population Bomb
effect: Single Target. Unique. Low Accuracy 2. Successive Actions.
description: The Pokémon and their family attack the foe in waves. Parents, children, cousins, aunts, uncles, and extended relatives, the whole family tree will appear in an onslaught.

name: Pounce
effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
description: The Pokémon stands very still, and just as their foe approaches, they suddenly launch into attacking.

name: Pound
effect: Single Target.
description: The user pounds the target’s head. Simple

name: Powder
effect: Single Target. Powder Move. The next time the Target uses a Fire-Type Move, Roll Typeless Damage Dice equal to that Move's power, ignore defenses.
description: The foe gets covered by a very flammable powder, the smallest source of fire will ignite it with explosive results.

name: Powder Snow
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze those affected.
description: A light layer of snow flakes covers the foes, as the layers pile up the possibilities to be trapped into the snow increase.

name: Power Gem
effect: Single Target.
description: With a crystal gem, the Pokémon will always save the day!

name: Power Shift
effect: Target Self. Switch the User's Strength with its Defense and its Special with its Sp. Defense.
description: The Pokémon knows that sometimes the best defense is a good offense.

name: Power Split
effect: Single Target. Average the User's Strength and Special with the Target's, rounded down.
description: Through a mental link both Pokémon are aware of each other strengths, which ends up evening the odds.

name: Power Swap
effect: Single Target. Whole Scene Duration. Switch the User's Strength and Special with the Target's.
description: The Pokémon enters their foe’s mind to steal its power and implant on them the idea of their own frailty.

name: Power Trick
effect: Target Self. Switch the User's Strength with their Defense and Special with their Sp. Defense.
description: The Pokémon tricks their own mind to believe their vitality is their power and vice versa.

name: Power Trip
effect: Single Target. *Add up to 7 Dice to the Damage Pool of this move for every Attribute increase the user has. (ie The user has 2 increased points on Defense, add 2 Damage dice).
description: In the heat of the battle, the Pokémon gets carried away, reveling in their own power.

name: Power Whip
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2.
description: A thick vine full of thorns is waved as a whip against the enemy. As devastating as the blow would be, the incoming attack is easily perceived by the foe.

name: Power-Up Punch
effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Increase User's Strength by 1.
description: A punch to test the impact’s surface and adjust the level of strength required to punch through it.

name: Precipice Blades
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Lethal. Unique. Ignore the Target's Immunity to Ground-Type Damage. If a Target is "Out of Range" due to using any Move, this Move hits anyways.
description: Giant blades emerge from the earth impaling the unlucky souls nearby. Do you think you are safe in the air? Think again...

name: Present
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. *Target rolls 1 die with a 50-50 chance of dealing 2 Set Damage to the Target or Restoring 2 HP to the Target.
description: The user hands out a lovely present box. Time to find out if the foe has been naughty or nice.

name: Prismatic Laser
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Must Recharge. Unique.
description: Through a prism, the user shoots a concentrated laser beam that pierces everything that comes in contact with it. The effort leaves the user mentally exhausted.

name: Protect
effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

name: Psybeam
effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
description: The foe’s mind is assaulted by a mental ray, afterwards they may suffer from hallucinations.

name: Psyblade
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Cutter Move. *If Electric Terrain is active, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move.
description: The Pokémon attacks using an ethereal blade. Electric energy will increase the sharpness of its edge.

name: Psych Up
effect: Single Target. The User gets the same Attribute/Trait Increases and Reductions the Target has.
description: The Pokémon mentalizes themselves stronger than anyone. They feel good. They can win. They. Can. Do. This!

name: Psychic
effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
description: The most iconic Psychic attack, the foe starts floating in the air and its swayed around by telekinesis as their mental barrier crumbles.

name: Psychic Fangs
effect: Single Target. Bite Move. If there is a Force Field on the Target's side of the field, destroy it.
description: The Pokémon bares its fangs to bite the foe, psychic energy begins piercing before the actual fangs make contact.

name: Psychic Noise
effect: Single Target. Target can't restore HP. Duration 2 Rounds.
description: The target gets a migraine so awful it can only hear white noise inside of its head.

name: Psychic Terrain
effect: Target Battlefield. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice to all Physical & Special Psychic-Type Moves. Pokemon without immunity to Ground can't use Moves with Reaction or Late Reaction. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: The arena becomes radiated by psychic waves. Everyone feels their mind slog due to the buzz in their heads, making all tasks take longer than they should.

name: Psycho Boost
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Unique. Reduce User's Special by 2.
description: The Pokémon releases an explosion of all of its concentrated psychic power in a devastating explosion, afterwards the user will be extremely tired.

name: Psycho Cut
effect: Single Target. Ranged. High Critical. Cutter Move.
description: The user sends out an invisible sword made with psychic energy that slashes targets even if they are far away.

name: Psycho Shift
effect: Single Target. Copy all of the User's Status Ailments into the Target. Afterwards, Heal the User from any Status Ailment.
description: Through sheer mental suggestion, the user actually makes their target feel their sickness. The user convinces themselves they are healed afterwards.

name: Psyshield Bash
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Increase by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
description: The user cloaks itself in a shield of psychic energy then rams into the foe.

name: Psyshock
effect: Single Target. This Move is resisted with the Target's Defense instead of its Sp. Defense.
description: The shock is mental, the blow is real.

name: Psystrike
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. This Move is resisted with the Foe's Defense instead of its Sp. Defense.
description: Through sheer psychic power, the user materializes its energy to deal a heavy strike to its foe.

name: Psywave
effect: Single Target. Roll Psychic-Type Damage Dice according to the User's Rank: Starter 1 Die / Rookie 2 Dice / Standard 4 Dice/ Advanced 6 Dice / Expert 8 Dice / Ace and forward 10 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
description: A powerful mental wave assaults the target’s brain directly. Everything, from forgotten memories to the secrets of the universe bombard its mind in just a few seconds.

name: Punishment
effect: Single Target. *Add up to 7 Dice to the Damage Pool of the Move for every Attribute increase the target has. (ie The target has 2 increased points on Strength, add 2 Damage dice).
description: You shouldn’t have done that...

name: Purify
effect: Single Target. Heal a Target's Status Ailment (Burns, Freeze, Paralysis, Poisons, Sleep). *If a Status Ailment was healed this way, the User may spend 1 Will point to restore 2 HP.
description: The target is covered by a gelatinous goo to which every impurity sticks. The user then convinces the target eats this goo, and ends up pleasantly surprised by the sweet flavor.

name: Pursuit
effect: Single Target. *If a Target hit by this Move is recalled, attempts to Run Away, uses a Switcher Move or is the Target of a Switcher Move, Deal 2 Typeless Damage to it. Outside of battle, aid in catching a fleeing target.
description: The Pokémon is relentless in its pursuit of their target, striking it just as it believed it had escaped.

name: Pyro Ball
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Projectile Move. Ranged. Roll 1 Chance die to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
description: The Pokémon lights a heavy stone on fire and kicks it while it’s ablaze. The hit is pretty heavy already, the fire is just for showing off.

name: Quash
effect: Single Target. Target's will go last in the Initiative Order. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon. If used again, the previous Target has their order in the initiative restored.
description: The user represses the foe through intimidation so it thinks twice before acting.

name: Quick Attack
effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Out of battle, double the Pokemon's movement speed.
description: An attack as fast as lightning.

name: Quick Guard
effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Reaction 3. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage from a Physical or Special Move with Priority. Negate the Added effects of Reaction and late Reaction Moves targeting the User and Allies.
description: The user reacts instinctively and defends itself and its team mates, nullifying the effects of the fastest attacks.

name: Quiver Dance
effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Dexterity, Special and Sp. Defense.
description: A mystical and beautiful dance that increases a Pokémon focus in combat.

name: Rage
effect: Single Target. If a foe damages the User with a Physical or Special Move in the same round after using this Move. Increase the User's Strength by 1. This effect can stack up to 3 Times.
description: The user gets angry and throws a tantrum against the foe. The more the battle continues the angrier the user gets.

name: Rage Fist
effect: Single Target. Fist Move. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move for every time the User has received Damage this Round, up to 8 Dice may be added this way.
description: The Pokémon focuses all of their rage into a single fist, the more they suffered the more dark energy will concentrate.

name: Rage Powder
effect: Target Self. Reaction 2. Powder Move. All of the Foe's Physical and Special Moves will Target the user if able. Duration 1 Round.
description: The Pokémon releases an irritating powder that itches and enrages its foes into full-attack mode.

name: Raging Bull
effect: Single Target. *The Type of this Move becomes the same as the User's Secondary Type if possible, otherwise their Main Type. This affects Weakness, Resistances and STAB accordingly.
description: The Pokémon charges against a foe, trampling through with a righteous fury, a blazing rage, a cold wrath, or maybe just the senseless desire for violence.

name: Raging Fury
effect: Target Random foe. Ranged. Rampage.
description: The Pokémon goes mad with rage, spitting fire viciously all over the battlefield and barely recognizing friend from foe.

name: Rain Dance
effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Rain Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: The Pokémon performs a peculiar dance in the middle of the field, everyone thinks it silly until the first thunder rumbles.

name: Rapid Spin
effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1. Remove Entry Hazards, Terrains (ie Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain), Ongoing Damage and Leech seed from the User and/or their side of the field.
description: The Pokémon makes a swift spin to strike at the foe and in the process everything laying close to the user is scattered out of the battlefield.

name: Razor Leaf
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Cutter Move. Ranged. High Critical.
description: The user sends out a barrage of sharp razor-like leaves. “Death by a thousand cuts” would be the best depiction.

name: Razor Shell
effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
description: The Pokémon sharpens a seashell to use as a cutting tool, when this shell manages to cut through the foe’s armor, they’ll finally have mastered their craft.

name: Razor Wind
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Charge Move. High Critical. Cutter Move.
description: The Pokémon sways the winds while charging what appears to be an invisible blade made of pressurized air. The wind slices everything it touches as if it were a razor.

name: Recover
effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
description: The Pokémon uses their energy to quickly mend wounds, their regenerative powers are beyond the imagination.

name: Recycle
effect: Target Self. The Pokemon reuses an Item (Berries, Potions, Full Heal, etc.) that has already been spent during the battle on any side of the battlefield. Recycle can't be used more than 3 times per battle by the User.
description: One Pokémon’s trash is another one’s treasure.

name: Reflect
effect: Target the User's side of the field. Force Field. Activate a Force Field against Physical Damage. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: An ethereal mirror-like wall cuts the battlefield in half, bouncing back the impact of most blows.

name: Reflect Type
effect: Target Self. Change the User's Type to match the one(s) of a foe. (ie Staryu is battle vs Charizard, their type will become Fire/Flying intead of Water) Whole Scene Duration.
description: The Pokémon is able to rewrite their own cellular composition at will to match that of potential predators. Increasing chances of survival.

name: Refresh
effect: Target Self. The User heals itself from any Burn, Freeze, Poison and Paralysis. Sleep is not healed through this effect.
description: The Pokémon takes a few seconds to cool off, refocus, and get back in the game.

name: Relic Song
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Unique. Roll 1 Chance Die to put the foe to Sleep. If successful, the User may choose to change its form afterwards.
description: The user sings and dances to a melody so beautiful you won’t notice you were crying while listening to it.

name: Rest
effect: Target Self. Complete Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Put the User to Sleep.
description: Yeah, this seems like a good spot to take a nap.

name: Retaliate
effect: Single Target. *If an Ally fainted during this or the previous Round, add Extra Dice to the damage pool, equal to the user's Loyalty. Up to 5 dice may be added this way. This effect only activates once per fainted Ally.
description: With tears of rage in their eyes, the Pokémon will not let the fall of a friend go without punishment.

name: Return
effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every point of Happiness on the User, up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
description: A loved Pokémon grows kind and happy, a Move fueled by gratitude.

name: Revelation Dance
effect: Single Target. *The Type of this Move becomes the same as the User's Main Type. This affects Weakness, Resistances, and STAB accordingly.
description: The Pokémon performs a dance, the dance’s energy influences the Type of this Move.

name: Revenge
effect: Single Target. *If the User has already received Damage this Round, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
description: Best served cold.

name: Reversal
effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool for every missing HP the User has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
description: The user gathers their mettle to block away the pain and focus only on hitting harder.

name: Revival Blessing
effect: Target One Ally. The User must spend all of their remaining Will points, if the user has no remaining Will points, this Move fails. Restore consciousness and 2 HP to a fainted ally. If no Ally is fainted this Move fails. The ally does not need to be active in combat.
description: The Pokémon prays to the skies with such selfless fervor and devotion that a miracle is granted.

name: Rising Voltage
effect: Single Target. Lethal. *If Electric Terrain is active, add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move.
description: A shockwave travels through the ground, then rises as a golden pillar of thunderbolts.

name: Roar
effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. Switcher Move for the Foe. In the wild, the battle may end.
description: With a potent roar, to make the foe reconsider their intentions.

name: Roar Of Time
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal. Unique. If successful, the target can't take any action unless they spend 1 Will point per action attempted. Duration 1 Round.
description: Through a terrifying roar, Dialga binds the forces of time on a single area, the unfortunate target will be trapped in a time warp, growing old in a matter of milliseconds.

name: Rock Blast
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Successive Actions. Projectile Move.
description: A rock shrapnel, the user shoots tiny bullet-like pebbles.

name: Rock Climb
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target. Out of battle it aids to climb cliffs and mountains with ease.
description: The Pokémon climbs over the foe and rests atop of their head as if it were the top of a mountain. This result is confusing for the foe.

name: Rock Polish
effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
description: Smooth the rough edges, no need to grind about in life.

name: Rock Slide
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch those affected.
